[EN] Suryati detects your interference.
[ES] Suryati detecta tu interferencia.

[EN] Garan is free! Talk to him.
[ES] ¡Garan es libre! Habla con él.

[EN] Garan summons a teleportal.
[ES] Garan invoca un teleportal.

[EN] Promise me that you'll avenge us.
[ES] Prométeme que nos vengarás.

[EN] I failed my queen today, but the war is far from over, mortal.
[ES] Hoy le he fallado a mi reina, pero la guerra está lejos de terminar, mortal.
